run_id.description: Identifier of the current computer-use run.

decision.description: Recommended decision shown to the reviewer.

question.description: Concrete approval question. It must name the exact action, target and consequence.

action_summary.description: One-sentence summary of the proposed UI action.

target_summary.description: Human-readable target: role, accessible name, URL and stable id when present.

risk_tags.description: Risk tags that justify approval or denial.

evidence.description: Evidence from the trace that the reviewer can inspect.

default_if_no_answer.description: Safe default when the human does not answer.
